capabilities: Add an implicit alias matching the first heading of a note
Use the heading alias for linking and unlinked mentions
Keep link display names in sync with heading changes
Fall back to the file name when headings are removed
Support both Wikilink and Markdown link formats
intentEvidence: Any aliases defined in YAML continue to behave in their standard way and do not affect the behavior of this plugin.
motivation: The author lists pain points: aliases are managed in YAML, which feels clumsy, and link display names do not stay in sync with alias changes.
problem: Aliases must be managed manually in YAML, and link display names do not stay in sync when aliases change.
summary: Adds an implicit alias matching a note's first heading and keeps link display names in sync when the heading changes.
